messages:
jamie: Hey team :wave: I'm Jamie — joined today. I'm trying to finish account setup but I'm stuck on Okta + Google + 1Password. Clicking the 'Activate Okta' link gives 'user not found' and I haven't gotten a 1Password invite. Who should I ping?
it-help: Hi Jamie, welcome! Sorry for the friction. Can you confirm the exact email you used on the offer?
jamie: jen.jamie@redwood.ai (that was on the offer letter)
it-help: Thanks — one sec while I check provisioning.
it-bot: Provisioning job 1762501229 queued for jen.jamie@redwood.ai
samir: Quick note — sometimes SCIM -> Google sync lags after Okta user creation. If SCIM didn't map the Google account, 1Password invite can bounce. I'll pull the SCIM logs.
it-help: I see an Okta user record but Google account creation is still pending. I'm going to trigger a manual SCIM sync now.
it-bot: SCIM sync triggered by samir at 2026-03-23T12:14:03Z — summary: 1 user updated, 0 errors
people-ops: Also check spam/promotions for 1Password invites (welcome@1password.com). Some clients filter them.
jamie: checked spam and promotions, nothing there yet.
it-help: Resent 1Password invite to jen.jamie@redwood.ai — you should get an email with subject: "You're invited to join 1Password". If it still doesn't arrive, let me know and I can add you via the admin panel.
jamie: OK I can see the 1Password email now, thanks. Clicking 'Activate Okta' still shows 'device enrollment required' when I open the link.
maria: For Okta Verify: install the Okta Verify app (iOS/Android), open the link in your desktop browser, then scan the QR from the "Set up Okta Verify" page. If you can't scan, click "Can't scan?" to enter a manual code.
jamie: Installed app and scanned QR — enrolled. Now when I try to sign in the MFA prompt comes up and I can approve.
ashley: Welcome aboard @jamie :tada: Once your Google account mapping finishes, ping me and I'll add you to the eng GitHub org and the repo teams.
jamie: Thank you everyone — Okta + 1Password working and I can access my mailbox now. Appreciate the quick help :thumbsup:
it-help: Glad it's resolved. Filed a short note in the onboarding checklist about the SCIM lag so we can troubleshoot if this pattern shows up again.
jamie: Awesome — feel free to reach out if you need me to test anything.
